title: Describing people
description: Say what someone is like, and what they do.
grammar: the irregular verbs and their adjectives
grammarNote: Adjectives come after the noun and agree with it: un trabajo difícil, una casa pequeña.

items.note: Good. It changes to buena before a feminine noun.
Bad. It changes to mala before a feminine noun.
Big. It does not change for a feminine noun.
Small. It changes to pequeña before a feminine noun.
New. It changes to nueva before a feminine noun.
Young. It does not change for a feminine noun.
Old. It changes to vieja before a feminine noun.
Masculine: el trabajo. It also means a job.
Masculine: el médico. The feminine is la médica.
